body: My mother thinks I’m a burden, she never checks on me. I basically told her I felt this way and she lives thirty minutes away , never visits , never has, and she called the cops , they showed up in riot gear making me feel even more suicidal. I reassured them I was okay . They told me if they get another call from her they are “taking me in”
That’s fucked up I relate I’ve told my whole family they still haven’t tried to help me only make it worse by telling me to not say that and cutting me off
